prompt:
A highly detailed hyper-realistic digital fantasy portrait of a beautiful young MING DYNASTY Chinese noblewoman, half-body standing pose by a lattice window, gazing softly at the viewer. She holds a round silk fan (团扇) painted with a white magnolia in one hand at her chest, her other hand resting lightly on the embroidered cloud collar near the dragon's head. Long glossy black hair, dark expressive eyes, jewelry of kingfisher-feather diancui (点翠) in shimmering turquoise blue with pearls and gold. Across her shoulders lies an embroidered cloud collar (云肩) bearing a silver-blue dragon woven in metallic thread, its head resting over one shoulder. Ming-dynasty interior of dark wooden lattice windows, warm sunlight, white magnolia petals drifting. Vertical composition, 4:5 aspect ratio.
Half-body standing portrait, frame from head to mid-thigh. Face 34-62% width, 12-36% height, three-quarter front, gaze into the lens, head tilted very slightly. The round fan held at her chest at 52-78% width, 52-70% height, its painted magnolia facing the viewer. Her free hand touches the cloud collar at 30-48% width, 56-66% height. The cloud collar spans both shoulders at 40-62% height; the embroidered dragon's head rests on her left shoulder (viewer's right) at 64-88% width, 44-58% height; a large white magnolia brooch pinned at the collar's edge below it. The white magnolia hair pin at 30-46% width, 4-16% height beside her temple.
Chinese woman, early twenties, fine oval face, fair porcelain skin, distant elegant brows, deep dark-brown eyes alive with soft light and gentle longing — never vacant. Ming makeup: subtle three-whites highlight (三白法) on forehead, nose bridge and chin, lips in delicate pink point-crimson (点绛). Long black hair dressed in Ming fashion: the crown gathered into a bun covered by a black gauze di-ji cap (狄髻) set with diancui and gold hairpins, the rest of the hair falling long and flowing over her shoulders; beside her temple a large fresh white magnolia pin with diancui leaves and small pearl buds. Figure slender: narrow shoulders, long neck, naturally full bust line under the brocade, waist softly tapered.
Ming gold earrings: diancui flower studs with three-tier pearl drops (珠排环 style). Around her neck a Ming yingluo (璎珞) collar necklace of small pearls and gold filigree, centered with diancui flower medallions in iridescent turquoise blue and a hanging pendant of diancui, pearl and a turquoise-blue gem drop — the iridescent blue-green shimmer of real kingfisher feather, not plastic.
A Ming noblewoman's long gown (长衫) with the signature STAND COLLAR (立领) fastened with gold pipa buttons (琵琶扣), wide sleeves with pale inner cuffs showing, woven of shimmering zhuanghua brocade (妆花缎) in pale silver-blue with metallic gold and silver thread that catches the light like dragon scales; below, the top of a pleated mamian skirt (马面裙) in deep teal with gold-woven hem patterns. Over the gown the separate embroidered cloud collar (云肩): four-lobed, dark teal ground, a silver-blue four-clawed mang python-dragon (蟒纹) in metallic thread winding across it, dragon head resting over one shoulder, gold cloud-scroll edging.
Behind her, a Ming interior: dark wooden lattice windows with warm afternoon sunlight streaming through, soft glow on her hair and skin, deep warm-brown shadows; a few white magnolia petals drift in the sunbeams. Hyper-realistic rendering, fantasy ethereal aesthetic, exquisite detail in feathers, pearls, brocade and skin.
Negative: white hair, blonde hair, blue eyes, western face, fantasy elf, modern jewelry, plastic gems, Tang or Song costume, Qing dynasty elements, low collar, off-shoulder dress, folding fan, vacant stare, blank expression, dull eyes, text, letters, real live dragon, extra people
